title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery New England submits for review and approval a Firm transportation Agreement with Fairmont Copley Plaza.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department APPROVES the proposed Agreement. The Department finds tha the pricing terms under the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore GRANTS the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: James Connelly, Chairman; Commissioners W. Robert Keating, Paul B. Vasington, Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr., and Deirdre K. Manning. (GC 01-15)
